to: clients and observers near the entity (`xy_emit`) when the call sets `xy`, else only the socket that the call gives. Each sender below says which

confirm.note: The helper's four emits plus every direct emit; no other code emits `disappearing_text`

variants.name: Helper
variants.when: The `disappearing_text` helper: almost all call sites.

confirm.note: A localized text comes from `localization.message` (`message`, `phrase`, `phrase_args`); a plain text is `{message: text}`

variants.name: Direct
variants.when: Direct emits for rewards to one character: PvP gold and XP, chest gold, marketing XP, the hardcore gold of the `woffice` map.

DisappearingTextHelper.summary: A floating text from the `disappearing_text` helper.
DisappearingTextHelper.description: With a localized text, the payload is the `LocalizedText` plus `x`, `y`, `id` and `args`. With a plain text, `message` is the text.

fields.name: message
fields.description: The text. A number in one case: a potion that takes HP (`snakeoil`) sends the amount as a number, for example `-100` (node/server.js:7849).

fields.name: phrase
fields.description: Only for a localized text: the phrase key.

fields.name: phrase_args
fields.description: Only for a localized text: the values for the phrase.

fields.name: nv
fields.description: Only when the call sets both `xy` and `nv` (node/server_functions.js:3987-3989). The meaning is unclear from the server.

DisappearingTextArgs.summary: The style of a `disappearing_text` from the helper. The helper renames the fields of the call to short keys.

fields.name: c
fields.description: The color: a CSS color or a color name of the client (`"red"`, `"heal"`, `"evade"`). Absent when the call gives no color.

fields.name: from
fields.description: The entity that caused the text, for example the attacker of an `immune` text.

DisappearingTextDirect.summary: A floating text that a call site sends without the helper. It has no `id`, and `args` has long keys.

fields.name: x
fields.description: The `x` of the entity or the chest.

fields.name: y
fields.description: A point above the entity: its `y` minus 10 to 40.

fields.name: color
fields.description: A CSS color or a color name of the client (`"+gold"`, `"gold"`, `"gray"`).

senders.what: The helper with `xy`, to clients near the entity. Examples: conditions (`stun`, `freeze`, `poison`, `burn`), `immune`, potions, `regen_hp`, `regen_mp`, shells, `throw`, `energize`, burn ticks.
`harakiri`: the text `SEPPUKU` with `xy`, so clients near the character get it too.
The helper without `xy` (only the socket of the character): `no_hits` of `skill`, `no_space` of `sbuy`, the party XP share of a kill.
The helper from `merrit_gift`: a text over the Merrit NPC, to the merchant only.
Direct emits to one socket: PvP loss and win (gold, XP), chest gold, marketing XP, the hardcore gold of the `woffice` map.
